content: {"summary":"Login requests to /v1/auth/login returned 503 errors that rose slowly in early April 2025; auth-db-01 was healthy but still presented an expired TLS certificate, causing auth-service connections to fail.","likely_cause":"PostgreSQL on auth-db-01 continued to use the expired certificate because it was not reloaded after renewal, so auth-service’s verify‑full TLS handshake rejected new connections, leading to the gradual increase in 503 responses.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Login endpoint returned 503 errors that increased gradually.","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#0"],"quote":"login error rate ... creeping up since roughly the top of the hour"},{"text":"auth-db-01 was reported healthy with no logs and fewer connections.","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#0"],"quote":"auth-db-01 looks healthy from the inside. Nothing in its log, fewer client connections than usual."},{"text":"auth-service pods logged failed dials due to expired certificate.","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#0"],"quote":"logs failed dials to auth-db-01 with `x509: certificate has expired`"},{"text":"The certificate file on disk had been renewed and was not expired.","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#1"],"quote":"certificate file on disk is a renewed one, ... expiry is well ahead"},{"text":"The server was still presenting the old expired certificate with a different serial.","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#1"],"quote":"s_client ... carries a different serial ... that certificate ran out at 09:00 today"},{"text":"Postgres kept the previous certificate in memory and did not reload it.","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#1"],"quote":"Postgres has kept the previous certificate in memory, and nothing has reloaded it"},{"text":"Connection pool retirement caused the gradual increase in 503s as new connections failed.","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#1"],"quote":"Our pool retires a connection after an hour, or after half an hour idle"},{"text":"Reloading PostgreSQL configuration restored the renewed certificate and stopped the 503 errors.","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#2"],"quote":"pg_reload_conf(); ... new connections succeed, the `503`s have stopped"}],"next_checks":["Add pg_reload_conf step to the auth-db certificate renewal job","Create alert on expiry of the certificate actually presented by auth-db, not just the file","Monitor auth-service connection pool for rising failed connections after cert changes","Periodically compare presented cert serial with the file serial on both primary and replica"]}
